resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com call the site Huckleberry Mountain. WillhiteWeb titles its page Huckleberry Ridge and says the lookout stood on the ridge toward Hurricane Peak, not on Huckleberry Mountain, calling the other placement probably a map error. The 5,856 ft elevation, 1935 L-5 cab and 1962 burning agree across sources, so they appear to describe one lookout. The story gives both names.

notes_for_editor: Core history (1935 L-5 cab, 1962 vandal burning, 5,856 ft) agrees across four sources. Today's condition rests on one undated WillhiteWeb trip account. Name/location conflict: see resolved_conflicts; brief coordinates (48.32211, -121.32375) match the register and firelookout.org list, but we could not confirm whether they mark the mountain or the ridge. A hikeoftheweek.com article (2024) returned HTTP 403 and is not cited; a search snippet from it mentions Glacier Peak Wilderness, which would bear on access if confirmed. Access level omitted: no source states whether public access is allowed today. Other Huckleberry Mountain lookouts (Lewis County, Colville NF, Ferry County) are different sites and were not used. FFLOS photo titles credit National Archives Pacific Northwest Region but give no image URLs, so no photos recorded.
